title: HShaggy Thai Whole Wheat Pilaf
description: A dehydrated and reconstituted whole wheat pilaf dish with a salty and shaggy texture suitable for a solo dinner in the style of Southern Thai cuisine.

ingredients.name: Curry Paste (optional)
ingredients.notes: Thai Red Curry or Green Curry can be used, but optional as the dish is already rich in spices.

instructions: Boil whole wheat pasta according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, warm chicken broth until slightly thickened.
Mix in sesame seeds, paprika, salt, garlic powder, and optional curry paste with the hot broth.
Add dehydrated red bell pepper if using, mix well into the stew.
Simmer for about 10 minutes to let flavors meld together.
Serve hot as a solo-dinner dish.
